statement.zh: Dillehay 主编 2017 年正式报告瓦卡普列塔、帕雷多内斯及下奇卡马前陶址 2006–2013 多学科发掘。
statement.en: Dillehay’s 2017 edited volume is the primary report of 2006–2013 multidisciplinary excavations at Huaca Prieta, Paredones, and lower Chicama Preceramic sites.
